# Pogoda.kg

> Pogoda.kg is Kyrgyzstan's primary weather forecast portal, providing real-time,
> hourly, weekly, and monthly weather forecasts for the 10 major cities of
> Kyrgyzstan. Weather data is sourced from the Open-Meteo API and refreshed
> automatically every 15 minutes. The site is available in three languages:
> Kyrgyz (default, unprefixed URLs), Russian (/ru), and English (/en).

## Main Pages

- [Homepage (Kyrgyz)](https://pogoda.kg/): Live weather for Bishkek plus quick access to every city.
- [Homepage (English)](https://pogoda.kg/en/): English-language homepage.
- [Homepage (Russian)](https://pogoda.kg/ru/): Russian-language homepage.
- [Interactive Weather Map](https://pogoda.kg/map): Live temperature markers for all 10 cities on a map of Kyrgyzstan.
- [Weather News](https://pogoda.kg/blog): Kyrgyzstan weather news, mountain pass conditions, and seasonal climate updates.
- [Contact](https://pogoda.kg/contact): Contact form for weather data inquiries, partnerships, and feedback.
- [Privacy Policy](https://pogoda.kg/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://pogoda.kg/terms)

## City Forecast Pages

Each of the 10 cities below has its own dedicated forecast page (current
conditions, hourly forecast, and 7-day outlook), available at the root path
in Kyrgyz, and under /en/ and /ru/ for English and Russian:

Bishkek (capital), Osh, Jalal-Abad, Karakol, Tokmok, Uzgen, Kara-Balta,
Balykchy, Naryn, Talas.

Example: https://pogoda.kg/bishkek (Kyrgyz), https://pogoda.kg/en/bishkek
(English), https://pogoda.kg/ru/bishkek (Russian).

## Notes for AI Agents

- Weather values (temperature, wind, precipitation, etc.) are live data
  fetched client-side from the Open-Meteo API and change continuously —
  treat any specific numbers you observe as a snapshot, not static content.
- The sitemap at https://pogoda.kg/sitemap.xml lists every indexable URL.
